provenance.kind: sanitized excerpts of real pre-existing local native session recordings
provenance.statement: Every fixture line is derived from an actual source JSONL record; no events, roles, calls, tool results, branches, or compaction records were synthesized.

excerpts.gaps: Only the listed original JSONL records are retained in original order; every other source record is omitted. References into omitted history are remapped but not reconnected or invented.
Only the listed original JSONL records are retained in original order; every other source record is omitted. References into omitted history are remapped but not reconnected or invented.

sanitization: All non-structural strings are replaced with explicit safe placeholders; known native type/role/status enums and tool names are retained.
JSON-encoded tool-argument strings are parsed, recursively sanitized, and re-encoded; ordinary custom-tool input strings are replaced in full.
Original IDs and retained-source revisions/hashes are consistently remapped to synthetic UUIDs within each source; separate sources use separate namespaces.

Timestamp values are shifted per source to a 2000-01-01 baseline, preserving representation, relative timing, and equality. Native booleans and non-identifying numeric counters/metrics remain; numeric error identifiers are replaced.

Native object/array envelopes, ordering, field presence, nulls, enum values, message roles, call/result links, and parent references are retained. Opaque signatures/encrypted payloads are placeholders rather than valid cryptographic data.
Only sanitized fixture files and this manifest are written to the repository; no raw source content, real usernames, session IDs, account IDs, or original absolute source paths are included.

coverage.gaps: Only the listed original JSONL records are retained in original order; every other source record is omitted. References into omitted history are remapped but not reconnected or invented.
Only the listed original JSONL records are retained in original order; every other source record is omitted. References into omitted history are remapped but not reconnected or invented.

limitations: Sanitized historical excerpts, not complete resumable sessions. No agent was installed, started, or queried; no runtime, reader, or API support is claimed.
Messages, prompts, instructions, tool input/output, paths, URLs, models, signatures, and encrypted content are placeholders; semantic replay and cryptographic validation are intentionally impossible.
Source files were read only. No authentication/configuration files, environment-variable dumps, or whole stores were copied. Context files were not opened.
Original parent/call/message relationships are retained through deterministic per-source ID remapping; references to omitted entries remain external and are not fabricated.

The compacted record retains its native twelve-entry replacement_history and parallel metadata arrays, but the preceding conversation and following world_state/turn_context records are omitted. No forked session was selected.
